notes.title: Second times update
notes.content:
Update:

1.Fixed a bug where the game would not correctly proceed to the ending if the boss and player died 
  simultaneously.
2.Fixed a bug where the player could not stop moving after interacting with an NPC.
3.Fixed a button issue caused by different screen aspect ratios.


Known Bugs:

1.If the player dies while holding a block, the walking animation may glitch after respawning.
  Please Try: After respawning, pick up the block again to return to normal.

2.Laser ad is triggered repeatedly.
  Temporary fix:
  Press "Esc" -> Main menu -> Continue game.
  Press the Windows key -> Close the game window -> Restart the game -> Continue game.

更新:
1.增加無敵偵避免重複傷害
2.修復對話框啟用時吳武正確暫停玩家的bug
